the mechanisms underlying the control of Ca2+ release and Ca2+ oscillation in pancreatic acinar and parotid cells, and how these mechanisms may be regulated by protein phosphorylation.
the role of calcium in the control of cell function.
the mechanisms underlying the generation and propagation of calcium oscillations in non-excitable cell types such as hepatocytes, pancreatic acinar cells and parotid cells.
